label: Donor Report Writer
description: Draft narrative donor reports and impact updates: progress vs targets, activities delivered, outcomes achieved, lessons learned, and financial narrative.

guidedInputs.label: Donor and grant reference
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. FCDO grant #300123, EU NDICI, private foundation

guidedInputs.label: Raw progress notes, monitoring data, and achievements
guidedInputs.placeholder: Paste field updates, indicator data vs targets, activity counts, stories of change, and anything else the report should draw on. Attach documents via the knowledge panel.

guidedInputs.label: Challenges, delays, and deviations from plan
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Procurement delayed 2 months by import restrictions; output 2 target unlikely to be met; security incident suspended field work in district X.

guidedInputs.label: Financial summary (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. 64% burn rate vs 75% time elapsed; underspend on training line due to delayed start.
